readerCopy.body: An old attraction, spending habit, or way of earning affection can feel especially persuasive. Venus conjunct the South Node can bring a former relationship pattern, familiar pleasure, old client, or predictable money choice back into focus. The pull may be warm, flattering, and genuinely enjoyable because you already know how this story works. Familiarity does not make it bad. It does make it worth asking what you are repeating. Keep the pleasure or value that still holds up, and stop paying for it with a pattern you no longer want.
